title: Imported code
description: What every node of an imported environment carries: its OpenTofu code, verbatim (docs/design/iac-import.md). The cloud-neutral types refer to these definitions for the nodes folded from imported code.

tf-type.description: Imported: the resource type it was read from, e.g. aws_s3_bucket (absent for a module call)

mode.description: managed (a resource block, the default), data (a data source) or ephemeral

source.description: Imported: the module source, for a module call

body.description: Arguments and nested blocks in source order. A string is an HCL expression exactly as written (a string literal keeps its quotes); an array holds the bodies of the nested blocks named by its key (`ingress`, `dynamic "ingress"`).

origin.description: Where an imported node came from. With it the node compiles back in its original shape at its original address; with shape "rhizo" (adopted) rhizo generates its code, and moves what it came from.

address.description: Its address in the original code, e.g. aws_s3_bucket.receipts or module.vpc

shape.description: resource, data, ephemeral or module; rhizo when adopted (rhizo generates its code from the props, and `address` and `also` are moved to it)

file.description: The file it was written in

also.description: Adopted: the satellite resources folded into it, moved into its code

keep.description: Adopted: arguments carried from the original code as HCL expressions, because changing them would rename, move or retag what exists (names, places, tags), by the input of rhizo's code that takes each (a path into one: `keys.key.name`)

name.description: Adopted: the name of rhizo's code for it when not the original's (`module.<name>`)
